## POST /v1/pdf/bookmarks/read

Reads the outline of each PDF sent, keyed by file name.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | files | Yes | The PDF to work on. Several for merge. |
| `outputFilename` | string | No |  |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Per file name | object |
| 400 | The request is wrong | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## POST /v1/pdf/bookmarks/write

Replaces the outline.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bookmarks` | JSON | Yes | JSON array of `{title, page, children}`. |
| `files` | file | Yes |  |
| `outputFilename` | string | No |  |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The PDF with its outline replaced | File |
| 400 | The request is wrong | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## POST /v1/pdf/convert

Gotenberg's `/forms/pdfengines/convert`: PDFs to PDF/A or PDF/UA through
LibreOffice, with the same post-processing fields.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | files | Yes | One or more documents. |
| `landscape` | boolean | No |  |
| `merge` | boolean | No | Merge several inputs into one PDF instead of returning a ZIP. |
| `nativePageRanges` | string | No |  |
| `outputFilename` | string | No |  |
| `password` | string | No | Opens a protected input. |
| `pdfa` | string | No | PDF/A level: `PDF/A-1b`, `PDF/A-2b`, `PDF/A-3b`, `PDF/A-4`. |
| `pdfua` | boolean | No | Export as PDF/UA. |
| `to` | string | No | Output format. Default `pdf`. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The converted PDF, or a ZIP of them | File |
| 204 | Accepted; the result goes to the webhook |  |
| 400 | The request is wrong | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | An engine is unavailable or the request timed out | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## POST /v1/pdf/sign

Places signature images at exact coordinates. This draws the image; it
is not a cryptographic signature.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | files | Yes | The PDF first, then one PNG or JPEG per placement. |
| `page` | integer | Yes | 1-based page of each signature; repeat the field for several. |
| `x` | number | Yes | Points from the page's left edge to the image's left edge. |
| `y` | number | Yes | Points from the page's bottom edge to the image's bottom edge. |
| `outputFilename` | string | No |  |
| `width` | number | No | Width in points. Default the image's natural size. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The signed PDF | File |
| 204 | Accepted; the result goes to the webhook |  |
| 400 | The request is wrong | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## POST /v1/pdf/split

Splits a PDF by page ranges or into fixed intervals; several outputs
come back as a ZIP.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | file | Yes |  |
| `splitMode` | string | Yes | `pages` or `intervals`. |
| `splitSpan` | string | Yes | For `pages`: ranges such as `1-3,5`. For `intervals`: pages per file. |
| `outputFilename` | string | No |  |
| `splitUnify` | boolean | No | For `pages`: one file holding every range instead of one per range. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A PDF, or a ZIP of PDFs | File |
| 400 | The request is wrong | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
